name: Infinity Loop
description: A dot travels continuously along an infinity symbol path in an elegant figure-eight motion

variations.name: default
variations.description: A dot traces the mathematical lemniscate (infinity symbol) path smoothly and continuously

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: pathColor
props.description: Color of the infinity path outline

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of the traveling dot in pixels

props.name: showPath
props.description: Whether to show the infinity symbol path outline

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
